Google Mantis: An Agentic Vulnerability Scanning Harness for Reducing False Positives
items.blurb: Google has open-sourced Mantis, an AI-agent framework designed to automate the software vulnerability lifecycle, from identifying and validating vulnerabilities to reproducing and fixing them.

items.title: How Figma Uses AI Agents for Security
items.blurb: The engineering team at software company Figma recently documented how they built AI agents to help their security team investigate alerts, search past incidents, check company systems, and even prepare code fixes.

items.title: Beyond Zero: Google Publishes Successor to BeyondCorp
items.blurb: In a recent research paper, Google introduced Beyond Zero, a “security model for the AI era” that extends Zero Trust to autonomous AI agents.

items.title: Airbnb Cuts Authentication Code by 60% with Server Driven Architecture
items.blurb: Airbnb redesigned its authentication architecture around server driven flows and policy based challenge selection.

items.title: Trusting-Trust Attack against an Entire Linux Distribution (via the strip utility)
items.blurb: "Ken Thompson's trusting-trust attack, in which a compromised compiler backdoors the programs it builds and reproduces the backdoor in subsequent rebuilds of itself, is widely regarded as a threat specific to compilers.
